blocks.text: 1 Samuel 25 contains 44 verses. It opens with: And Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran. It concludes with: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: First Samuel moves from Eli's failing priestly house through Samuel's prophetic leadership and Saul's rejected kingship to David's anointing, rise, exile, and Saul's death.
